purpose: First actual finite catalogue navigation after native complete-result checkpoint.
conditions: All; each final mask; exact 3 edges; at most 4 and 6 edges; 8 through 10 edges; zero or one empty relation; contradictory final constraints; required or forbidden state 0; reversed and negative edge bounds; adaptive fixed relation codes from the first all-family witness.
queries: Summary, full two-state identity records, first/middle/last ranks for each nonempty initial condition and their inverse, first/last 32 pages, complete exact-three-edge page, empty end/zero-size pages, one nonmember rank, three run-boundary traces and new relation powers. Then three fixed-relation conditions from the first witness.
retention: Every request, response, error and latest cache/work retained. No constructor, old power product, old DFA evaluation, expanded word or external proof rerun.
order: table code A+512*B ascending, then final mask ascending
boundaries: Final mask 7 is not presumed empty: rejection is possible when the second reachable subset is empty.
